objective.statement: The application has a suitable favicon.

complexity.rationale: One static asset plus one link tag in index.html; no state, contracts or approval-boundary work.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: index.html declares an icon link whose href points to a favicon file that exists in public/.
The favicon is a project-specific SVG, no longer the default Vite logo (vite.svg is not referenced).

in.statement: public/favicon.svg (new) and the icon link in index.html.
src/lib/favicon.unit.test.ts verifying the link and the asset.

out.statement: PNG/ICO/apple-touch icons, web manifest, deleting public/vite.svg (rm is not available to the executor), and earlier slices' workflow records.

observations.statement: No design was supplied, so the favicon is a simple SVG torus-style ring on a dark rounded square, matching the app's torus widgets; a single SVG is supported by all current browsers.
public/vite.svg is left in place, unreferenced, as follow-up debt for deletion.

unit.rationale: Reads index.html and public/ as raw text to verify the icon link and asset.

integration.rationale: No cross-module flow; npm run test runs as regression.

e2e.rationale: Static head metadata with no user flow.

increments.behavior: index.html links a project-specific SVG favicon that exists in public/.
increments.doneWhen: t-1 passes and the full suite, lint and build stay green.

tests.description: index.html has an icon link to /favicon.svg, public/favicon.svg is an SVG document, and vite.svg is not referenced.

expectedRedEvidence.expectedFailure: index.html still links /vite.svg and public/favicon.svg does not exist.
expectedRedEvidence.observedFailure: Failed to resolve import ../../public/favicon.svg?raw: the asset does not exist yet, so the suite fails with 0 tests run.

verification.requirement: npm run test, npm run lint and npm run build pass.
verification.command: npm run test; npm run lint; npm run build
verification.result: unit 33/33, component 66/66, lint clean, tsc and vite build succeeded
